**Finding: deviation** (Section 12.4, ¶p0045)

Section 12.4 imposes a one-sided, 24-month **no-hire** on Customer covering *any* Vendor employee, and expressly negates any carve-out ("regardless of how the employee applies"). This is walk-away territory under NOSOLICIT and fails the fallback on all four material terms (mutuality, scope, duration, carve-outs). It also directly conflicts with Section 12.3, which states Customer has made no no-hire commitment and may hire anyone responding to general recruitment.

Redline validated (ok:true) and submitted: replaced with a mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and the hiring/employment restriction deleted — our fallback position, per the rule's redline guidance. Preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer) noted in the comment.
